title: Pin canonical issue bytes with synthetic fixtures against the real API
description: Commit 1de17e2 (PR #60, claude/kanbus-multiboard-phase-b) adds four synthetic fixtures (prsp-00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 to 04) and test/integration/canonical-bytes.integration.ts, which pin the bytes of canonical issue files against the real API so the multi-board cutover can prove canonical S3 keys and bytes are unchanged (see kanbus-0ec206 step 3). Not yet on main; it lands with PR #60. Filed 2026-10-20 because the commit had no issue.
